import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int m = scanner.nextInt();
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = scanner.nextInt();
        }

        int splitPoint = n / 2;
        List<Integer> leftPart = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> rightPart = new ArrayList<>();

        generateLeft(a, 0, 0, splitPoint, m, leftPart);
        generateRight(a, splitPoint, n, 0, m, rightPart);

        Collections.sort(leftPart);
        int maxSumValue = 0;

        for (int val : rightPart) {
            int target = m - val;
            int position = lowerBound(leftPart, target);
            if (position > 0) {
                int candidateSum = leftPart.get(position - 1) + val;
                if (candidateSum > maxSumValue) {
                    maxSumValue = candidateSum;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(maxSumValue);
        scanner.close();
    }

    private static void generateLeft(int[] a, int index, int total, int splitPoint, int m, List<Integer> leftPart) {
        if (index == splitPoint) {
            leftPart.add(total);
        } else {
            generateLeft(a, index + 1, (total + a[index]) % m, splitPoint, m, leftPart);
            generateLeft(a, index + 1, total, splitPoint, m, leftPart);
        }
    }

    private static void generateRight(int[] a, int index, int n, int total, int m, List<Integer> rightPart) {
        if (index == n) {
            rightPart.add(total);
        } else {
            generateRight(a, index + 1, n, (total + a[index]) % m, m, rightPart);
            generateRight(a, index + 1, n, total, m, rightPart);
        }
    }

    private static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int key) {
        int low = 0;
        int high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) < key) {
                low = mid + 1;
            } else {
                high = mid;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }
}
